name: Grand Class
verdict: Grand Class is the luxury car-rental brand of Lopez Rubio Grand Class SL (Madrid), a single-member company of the private family holding UPCYCLING HOLDING SL. No state owner identified. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Getafe CF's official announcement (14 August 2025) describes Grand Class as a luxury-vehicle rental company in Madrid with a three-season deal covering the back of the shorts. Private Spanish family capital throughout; no state owner appears anywhere in available material.
